## 4. Flagship Case Studies

### Case Study 1: Cloud Backend Optimization & Google Cloud Run Serverless Migration
- **Problem**: Legacy backend running 24/7 on dedicated virtual machines incurred continuous monthly bills regardless of actual incoming traffic volume.
- **Solution**: Containerized the application using Docker, separated static assets into Google Cloud Storage, optimized warm startup times, and migrated to Google Cloud Run serverless containers with concurrency tuning (80 concurrent requests per instance).
- **Result**: Monthly cloud bill decreased from $17.92 to $1.40 (>90% reduction) with automated scale-to-zero when idle and instant scale-up under peak traffic.
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/Anandhu362/Cloud-Cost-Optimization
- **Technical Articles**: Published on Blogger and Medium.

### Case Study 2: CloudDrive App Platform
- **Problem**: Need for a secure, multi-tenant file management system offering private cloud storage without vendor lock-in.
- **Solution**: Engineered a full-stack platform using Node.js, Express, React, and Google Cloud Storage. Implemented cryptographic file integrity hashing, password-protected download links, storage quota tracking per user, and zero-duplication metadata synchronization.
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/Anandhu362/Clouddrive-App-Projects-Detailes

### Case Study 3: Ferrari Foods LLC Enterprise Cash Vault Ledger
- **Problem**: Manual reconciliation across enterprise food distribution routes led to discrepancies in cash collections and bank deposits.
- **Solution**: Built a high-integrity dual-entry cash vault ledger on GCP Compute Engine with Caddy reverse proxy, automated rollbacks, and agent mobile interfaces. Integrated Baileys automated WhatsApp notification triggers for instant receipt generation.
- **Metric**: Reconciled >AED 1,000,000 in cash transactions across Sharjah and Abu Dhabi branches.
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/Anandhu362/ferrarimanagement2

### Case Study 4: Up4TexAll (Re4Circular) Sustainable Fashion Portal
- **Problem**: Textile waste and lack of commercial circularity for second-hand textiles.
- **Solution**: Built an interactive textile marketplace portal combining buyer/seller listings with Google Gemini AI API to generate upcycled design ideas and material reuse classifications from uploaded garment photos.
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/Anandhu362/up4texall-Projects-Detailes

### Case Study 5: Custom Hardened WireGuard Cloud VPN
- **Problem**: Securing remote operational access to cloud databases and internal servers.
- **Solution**: Configured a kernel-level WireGuard VPN server on Ubuntu Linux in Google Cloud Platform with strict UFW firewall policies, persistent keepalives, and encrypted peer-to-peer tunnels.
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/Anandhu362/Virtual-Private-Server-
